## What and why · 改了什么、为什么

## Checklist · 检查清单

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] User-visible behavior changes update `docs/spec/` and the Unreleased section of `CHANGELOG.md` · 用户可见的行为变化已同步规范与 CHANGELOG
- [ ] Rendering changes come with snapshot tests · 渲染改动附带快照测试
- [ ] Verb list, stopword and naming changes say in CHANGELOG which canonical names they affect · 动词表、停用词、命名规则的改动在 CHANGELOG 写明影响哪些规范写法
- [ ] No resolved credential values in output, logs or snapshots · 输出、日志、快照里没有解析后的凭证值
